description: This file contains helper functions for configuring and calculating PDCCH and PUCCH resources in a 5G NR scheduler, including resource list building and candidate count computations based on various configurations.

methods.name: build_pucch_resource_list
methods.description: Builds a list of PUCCH resources based on user parameters and BWP size.

methods.name: compute_tot_nof_monitored_pdcch_candidates_per_slot
methods.description: Calculates the total number of monitored PDCCH candidates per slot based on serving cell and DL config.
